decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The rooflights in the development to which this permission relates shall be of a conservation style, constructed in timber and set flush with the plane of the roof in which they are inserted. The rooflights shall be permanently retained in this style. Reason: To prevent harm to the significance of designated heritage assets, in accordance with policy HC1 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM12 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission ref: 24/03212/HOU dated 21.02.2025 .Reason: As required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Safety Statement submitted on 25 December 2024 unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to carry out development without compliance with Condition 1 (Approved Drawings) of planning permission 24/03212/HOU (Erection of front and rear dormer roof extensions with installation of 2nos. rooflights to the front gable roof and 2nos. rooflights to the rear roof slope. Alterations to existing rear dormer roof extension. Removal of chimney.) to alter the approved flat roof dormers to pitched roof dormers
